rows: Two mathematical constructions yield 233, but both contain unverified operational assumptions. Their agreement does not establish independence from target selection.
Aleph's mediating role is textually grounded. The specific binary activation rule and numerical weight of two are proposed.
The attribution is compatible with the activation interpretation, but zero does not uniquely represent an operator.
W72's $\mathbb Z_2$ is Aleph's activation bit
Both are binary structures. A shared cardinality is not an identification.
12→13 is activation without a new position
The Fibonacci construction **adds a position**\. A pure register change requires a different definition.
The equalities are exact, but they do not represent three independent derivations of the same physical or symbolic process.
SUN and Aleph have the same algebraic form
SUN composes multiplicative transformations. The Aleph model changes edge weights. Those operations have not been shown to be algebraically equivalent.
